objects.prompt_binding: CREATE TABLE "prompt_binding" ("input_id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(input_id)=32 AND input_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), "stage" TEXT NOT NULL, "assignment_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "execution_id" TEXT, "attempt_ordinal" INTEGER, "owner_lookup" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_thread" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_generation" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (owner_generation>0), "wire_root_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "expected_prompt_digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "bound_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (bound_at_ms>0), PRIMARY KEY ("input_id"), CHECK ((stage='triage' AND execution_id IS NULL AND attempt_ordinal IS NULL) OR (stage='full' AND execution_id IS NOT NULL AND attempt_ordinal>0)), CHECK (length(owner_lookup)=32 AND owner_thread<>'' AND length(wire_root_id)=32 AND wire_root_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND source_seq>0 AND message_id<>'' AND length(expected_prompt_digest)=64 AND expected_prompt_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID
objects.prompt_binding_delete_guard: CREATE TRIGGER prompt_binding_delete_guard BEFORE DELETE ON prompt_binding BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'prelaunch binding is immutable'); END
objects.prompt_binding_update_guard: CREATE TRIGGER prompt_binding_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON prompt_binding BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'prelaunch binding is immutable'); END
